name: Barranquilla
scopeLimits: Exact ranked-top1000 locator is [10.9437023278669, -74.7962611088146], converted to an approximately 20 m WGS84 envelope for the bounded query capped at three results. The WUP point is not a parcel identity or official city boundary. Mi Ciudad’s active bundle identifies the Predios_2026 parcel service. A normal public retry with Mi Ciudad Origin and Referer headers reached Cloudflare and returned HTTP 403; no verification challenge, login or CAPTCHA was completed. No owner/address fields or data were saved.

registryBasis: Barranquilla’s official Gerencia de Gestión Catastral operates Mi Ciudad; its active app bundle identifies the Predios_2026 parcel MapServer and FeatureServer. Direct public REST reads, including a bounded three-result retry with normal Mi Ciudad Origin/Referer headers, received Cloudflare HTTP 403. Service presence is confirmed, but geometry remains unreadable here.

officialSources.observation: Official Barranquilla Catastro portal; municipal cadastral management entry point.
Official Catastro services page describes interoperability and public OGC web services.
Official Mi Ciudad parcel-query app shell retrieved with official Catastro Referer.
Viewer bundle defines ArcGIS Predios_2026 MapServer/0 query and Predios_2026 FeatureServer; layer metadata marks the parcel service with role Seguridad_Catastro.
Cloudflare challenge page; layer schema could not be retrieved.
Bounded WUP-point query used an approximately 20 m envelope, OBJECTID only, returnGeometry=true and resultRecordCount=3; Cloudflare blocked the request, so no features returned.

viewerAndServiceTrace.accessObservation: Bundle associates Predios_2026 with role Seguridad_Catastro. Previous metadata and bounded point query returned 403. Follow-up browser route navigation displayed Cloudflare “Performing security verification”; no challenge was completed. The local requests retry with Origin https://miciudad.barranquilla.gov.co and its public Mi Ciudad Referer failed at DNS resolution before transmission. No authentication, CAPTCHA solving or private endpoints attempted.
